run_self_auto_bleu_cli: run the self/auto BLEU metrics CLI with --manifest and --prompts-description flags on ASR transcripts
compute_auto_bleu: compute the auto BLEU score for a single sentence using n-gram self-match with arithmetic or geometric weighting
compute_self_bleu: compute self BLEU scores for a list of utterances by comparing each against all others
get_target_sequences: extract target sequence IDs from a manifest file filtered by ground truth durations
run_all_bleu_metrics: run all 8 self and auto BLEU metric variants in parallel across ASR transcript utterances
